fr.elements: Main Building; Secondary Building; Detached Building; Rooftop Equipment; Rooftop Equipment; Internal Drive Aisle; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Service Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Structures; Limited Rear Access; Single Access Point
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the single access point with a clearly visible address sign readable from the approaching roadway.
• Post a site map showing the locations of all three buildings at the access point entrance to orient arriving responders.
• Mark the internal drive aisle with directional signage to guide responders to each building.
• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles to maintain continuous movement between structures.
• Identify and mark a designated staging area within the vehicle parking area for emergency vehicles.
• Mark the secondary and detached buildings with individual unit or building identifiers visible from the drive aisle.
• Identify and mark the rear of the main building to alert responders to limited rear access conditions.
• Keep the service area clear of stored materials that would block responder access along that side of the property.
• Mark walkways connecting buildings so responders can move between structures on foot without confusion.
• Confirm rooftop access points for all three buildings are labeled at ground level near each structure's entrance.

wildfire.conditions: Large Paved Area; Open Paved Area; Scattered Trees; Scattered Trees; Limited Vegetation Separation; Vegetation Near Building; Multiple Access Routes; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim or remove shrubs and low branches where vegetation is growing directly against or close to building walls.
• Keep the area between scattered trees and building exteriors clear of dead leaves, fallen branches, and accumulated plant debris.
• Maintain open paved areas free of any vegetation encroachment along edges and expansion joints.
• Thin or remove vegetation in locations where plants are concentrated close to building entrances or along foundation lines.
